title: Dual-mode Staging ingress and Custom GPT MCP bootstrap

phases.objective: Make local Windows/Docker Staging ingress mode explicit and mutually exclusive, self-heal the Windows Cloudflared service to token-file transport, prove the shared remote-managed loopback origin from fresh runtime evidence, bind published Admin/Tenant/Activation OpenAPI schemas to exact-checkout semantic content, require real Tenant OAuth plus Remote MCP OAuth authenticated read E2E with zero durable probe residue before PLATFORM_READY, and bind every new dual-mode runtime dependency into the governed portable Staging manifest.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: PLATFORM_READY is emitted only when the selected Staging tunnel is mutually exclusive and stable, Cloudflare runtime evidence binds dev.mad4b.com and mcp_dev.mad4b.com to http://127.0.0.1:8080, published schemas are semantically identical to the exact checkout, Admin read-only auth succeeds, Tenant OAuth authorization-code plus PKCE reaches an authenticated Tenant read, Remote MCP OAuth reaches list_accessible_workspaces, probe residue is zero, the Activation Gateway is enabled and ready, and the portable Staging manifest covers the complete dual-mode runtime dependency graph.
steps: Generate missing local-only Staging secrets once through Staging-Environment.ps1 while preserving existing non-placeholder values.
Preserve explicitly configured STAGING_READINESS_PROBE_USER_ID and STAGING_READINESS_PROBE_TENANT_ID; never auto-select or auto-create a readiness principal.

Generate a Staging-prefixed Remote MCP App ID, confidential App Secret, isolated OAuth signing secret, Tenant GPT OAuth secrets, and database/runtime secrets into ignored .env.staging without committing values.
Reject persisted Remote MCP authorization codes, access tokens, or refresh tokens; user tokens are minted only by the runtime OAuth authorization-code flow.
Quiesce both tunnel runtimes before the exact-SHA transition, then activate only windows_service, docker_sidecar, or disabled.
For windows_service publish app only on 127.0.0.1:8080, reconcile Cloudflared to --token-file with protected token/log files, require a stable PID window, and prove Docker cloudflared is inactive.
For docker_sidecar share the app network namespace, use the same remote-managed http://127.0.0.1:8080 origin, require the ignored Staging tunnel token, and prove the Windows service is inactive.
Read fresh cloudflared runtime evidence and fail closed if either Staging hostname is still mapped to http://app:8080 or if the canonical remote-managed origin cannot be proven.

Fetch Tenant/Admin/Activation Staging OpenAPI schemas over public HTTPS, parse them, validate server/security/OAuth/operationId/local-ref semantics, and require semantic equality with the exact-checkout canonical files.
Perform a bounded authenticated Admin GPT read-only probe with the Staging backend key.
When explicitly requested, provision the openai_chatgpt Remote MCP client inside the Staging app container using the generated App ID/App Secret and require secret-redacted status readback.

Issue a bounded platform JWT for the configured existing Staging principal, complete Tenant OAuth authorization-code with PKCE S256, exchange the code, and read /connect/status with the minted bearer.
Complete Remote MCP authorization-code OAuth with PKCE S256 using the provisioned Staging MCP App, call list_accessible_workspaces through POST /mcp, and revoke minted MCP tokens.
Delete probe-created Tenant OAuth codes/grants/SSO/activation-context/diagnostic evidence and Remote MCP codes/grants, then require probe_residue=0.

Regenerate the portable Staging manifest through its canonical generator so the One-Click launcher, helpers, mode-specific Compose overrides, OAuth/MCP readiness scripts, and exact Staging OpenAPI files are hash-bound before closure passes.
Require the Activation Gateway for PLATFORM_READY; disabled remains local-only and cannot claim platform readiness.

Block platform readiness if any selected tunnel, remote-origin, public HTTPS, schema semantic, Admin auth, Tenant OAuth/action, Remote MCP OAuth/read, cleanup, Activation, or portable-manifest gate fails.
assertions: windows_service and docker_sidecar are first-class mutually exclusive modes; disabled remains available for local-only Staging and never claims PLATFORM_READY.
Both enabled tunnel modes use the externally reviewed remote-managed origin http://127.0.0.1:8080; mode switching performs no Cloudflare/provider mutation.
Windows Service uses loopback-only host publication, protected --token-file transport, bounded service recovery, stable process readback, and fresh log evidence; inline --token is forbidden.
Docker sidecar shares the app network namespace so its loopback origin resolves to the app while requiring no host publication.
Staging-Environment.ps1 is the canonical source of newly generated .env.staging values and does not implicitly rotate populated values.
STAGING_READINESS_PROBE_USER_ID and STAGING_READINESS_PROBE_TENANT_ID must identify one existing active Staging membership; readiness cannot manufacture a user or tenant.
REMOTE_MCP_APP_ID uses the mcp_stg_ namespace and REMOTE_MCP_APP_SECRET is at least 32 characters of cryptographically random material.
REMOTE_MCP_OAUTH_SIGNING_SECRET remains isolated from JWT_SECRET and MCP user authorization/access/refresh tokens are not persisted in .env.staging.
MCP client provisioning requires the explicit PROVISION_REMOTE_MCP_STAGING confirmation and executes against the Staging Runtime DB from inside the app container.
Canonical App Secret provisioning output is redacted and status/readback remains secrets_included=false.

Published Tenant/Admin/Activation/MCP schema bindings are validated semantically, including servers, security schemes, OAuth endpoints, unique operationIds and resolvable local refs, and must match exact-checkout semantic hashes.
Tenant readiness requires platform-jwt -> authorize -> code -> token -> authenticated /connect/status with PKCE S256 and subject binding to the configured probe principal.
Remote MCP readiness requires authorize -> code -> token -> authenticated list_accessible_workspaces with PKCE S256 using the provisioned Staging MCP App.
Probe cleanup is fail-closed and PLATFORM_READY requires probe_residue=0 after deleting probe-owned Tenant/MCP authorization artifacts.

The portable Staging manifest must hash-bind the dual-mode One-Click launcher, environment and Windows Cloudflared helpers, both mode-specific Compose overrides, MCP provisioner, semantic/authenticated readiness scripts, and exact Tenant/Admin/MCP/Activation Staging OpenAPI surfaces.
The portable manifest generator itself is manifest-bound so changes to the dependency authority cannot silently bypass closure.
Activation Gateway is mandatory for PLATFORM_READY.
Admin/Tenant Staging schema URLs and MCP resource URLs remain on dev.mad4b.com, activation-dev.mad4b.com, and mcp_dev.mad4b.com only.
No Production deployment, Production database mutation, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, provider mutation, ruleset mutation, or production_live authority is granted.

phases.objective: Review shared Remote MCP provisioning compatibility without granting Production activation or mutation authority.
blockers: Production remains outside this pull request and requires a separate governed promotion lifecycle.
The shared provisioner explicitly refuses Staging REMOTE_MCP_APP_ID/REMOTE_MCP_APP_SECRET variables when environment=production.
No Production, Hostinger, Cloudflare, provider, production database, ruleset, or deployment mutation is authorized by this declaration.
